package.description: Library for conversion between Traditional and Simplified Chinese

zh-TW.description: Library for conversion between Traditional and Simplified Chinese
zh-TW.longDescription: Open Chinese Convert (OpenCC) is an opensource project for conversions between Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese and Japanese Kanji (Shinjitai). It supports character-level and phrase-level conversion, character variant conversion and regional idioms among Mainland China, Taiwan and Hong Kong. This is not translation tool between Mandarin and Cantonese, etc.
zh-TW.name: OpenCC
